source.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)
source.epoch: ICRS/J2000 equinox; source astrometry primarily Hipparcos-2007 reduction, epoch J1991.25
source.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
source.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

galacticFrame.source: Hipparcos Catalogue vol. 1 §1.5.3 (ESA SP-1200, 1997); J2000 galactic frame constants shared by astropy and SOFA

panorama.title: The Milky Way panorama
panorama.longitudeConvention: l = 0 at the column centre, increasing leftward (sky seen from inside)
panorama.latitudeConvention: b = +90 at row 0, -90 at the last row

catalogRegistration.role: retained source record only; the photograph is registered astrometrically and owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky sampled in ICRF through the J2000 galactic frame and the anchor-registered panorama; the scene registration carries the Miranda pole and epoch; Solar System objects in the mosaic are capture artefacts; no Sun is baked into the cubemap
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: Vendored JPL Horizons Uranus satellite elements and IAU/NAIF Miranda rotation at the shared epoch.
provenance.qualification: Computed Miranda Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 mosaic with source photometric correction. Native detail varies; local cast shadows and image seams remain. Gray grid marks missing observations.
controls.title: Monochrome mosaic
controls.summary: Illumination is corrected, but cast shadows and image seams remain. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing observations.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Stereogrammetry and photoclinometry, in kilometres above the published reference ellipsoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements. 240 m grid spacing is not uniform effective resolution.
controls.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
controls.summary: Height from stereo images and shading, relative to the source ellipsoid. Detail varies; gray grid: no measurements.

controls.label: Geology
controls.description: Eighteen historical geologic units digitized from Voyager-era mapping. Registration reconstructed from the published map grid; three independent crater checks differ by about 1.3–3.3° (5–14 km). Colors identify interpreted units, not measured composition. Gray grid marks unmapped or unresolved overlapping units; structural linework is not shown.
controls.summary: Historical interpreted units; degree-scale registration limits. Gray grid: unmapped or conflicting units.
